claim: The second Stick definition (284895) is the FakeStick object inside the Firewood Yard: one Log becomes four FakeStick, and each FakeStick becomes one Stick (284894). Both share the localization key Resource.Stick, so both display as Stick; the item the stockpile counts is 284894.

evidence.reference: ResourceBehaviour 284895 sits on GameObject "FakeStick" under the Woodchopper prefab; 284894 on "Stick". Decoded with the pure-Python IL2CPP reader (outlanders2-research, tools/decode_classes.py), every record consumed to its exact length.

notes: Level objective totals merge the two by name, so the Log cost of sticks is counted once.
